chunks: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم passed by a man who had goods with him that he wanted to sell, and he said, "Keep to the beginning of the market."

key_terms.أَوَّلِ السُّوقِ: the beginning of the market, the place the seller was directed to
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the one giving the instruction
key_terms.بَيْعَهَا: selling it, meaning the sale of the merchandise
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man encountered by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.سِلْعَةٌ: goods or merchandise intended for sale

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instruct a seller to do in the market?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم directed a seller to the beginning of the market. It indicates Prophetic guidance concerning marketplace conduct and the etiquettes of trade.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3739 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) passed by a man who had goods he wanted to sell and said to him, "Go to the beginning of the market."
